packages.prose_explanation: This section details the architectural realization of embedding enrichment and hybrid attention. The process begins by augmenting static retriever embeddings with document ID and sinusoidal position encodings to inject structural identity and ordering signals. These enriched embeddings, along with the static query, are processed through a Transformer encoder stack. Each layer employs a hybrid attention mechanism: a shared full attention module captures global cross-passage interactions, while a dedicated masked attention module enforces intra-document coherence by restricting attention to passages from the same document. This dual-path attention allows the model to consolidate local document-level context while maintaining global relevance signals.

formula_obligations.mathematical_goal: Start with pre‑computed dense passage embeddings from a standard retriever (e.g., Contriever) and the query embedding from the same encoder. Augment each passage embedding with a document ID embedding (relative to the current retrieved set) and a sinusoidal passage‑position encoding to inject structural cues. Process the query and enriched passage embeddings jointly through a stack of Transformer encoder layers that use a hybrid attention mechanism: a shared full attention module for global interactions, and a dedicated masked attention module that restricts attention to passages from the same document, to consolidate intra‑document coherence. Optimize the model with a contrastive loss (InfoNCE) that uses the fixed original query embedding as an anchor, pulling the contextualized positive passage embedding closer and pushing negatives away. At inference, compute dot‑product similarity between the static query embedding and the updated passage embeddings, then rank passages in descending order of these scores.

shared full attention module: Standard multi‑head attention allowing query and all passages to attend to each other;

dedicated masked attention module: Masked multi‑head attention that restricts a passage to attend only to the query and to other passages from the same document, enabling fine‑grained coreference resolution and local coherence.
